name: Mento Colombian Peso
oneLiner: COPm is Mento's Colombian peso stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing COPm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the COPm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes rates through SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-hours feeds before swaps/CDP routes use them.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: COPm inherits upstream freeze exposure because the Mento reserve mix includes tracked freezable stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, and EURC.

mintAuthority.summary: COPm is minted via the Mento Broker (0x777A...) which is the sole authorized minter (broker() getter confirmed). The Broker's proxy admin and the COPm token owner and proxy admin all resolve to the Mento Timelock (0x890DB...) with a 2-day delay.

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for COPm
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, broker() on COPm (0x8a567e2ae79ca692bd748ab832081c45de4041ea) returned 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD (Mento BrokerProxy). The Broker's EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147 (Mento Timelock).

controls.label: Mento Timelock — COPm token owner and proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, owner() on COPm returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned the same address. getMinDelay() on the Timelock returned 0x2a300 = 172800 seconds (48 hours).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69287341: owner() = Timelock 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147 (confirmed); EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = same Timelock; getMinDelay() = 172800s (48h); broker() = 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD (Mento BrokerProxy, confirmed as sole authorized minter); Broker EIP-1967 proxy admin = same Timelock. Celo Registry confirms Broker = 0x777A... All mint-capable surfaces resolved.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: COPm has a single Celo deployment in the reviewed metadata and Celo's local-stablecoin docs list COPm as a Mento stablecoin on Celo. No material bridge route is resolved for this row.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: COP is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so COPm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.
